# Helpa — WhatsApp AI Receptionist & CRM

> Helpa is a 24/7 AI-powered WhatsApp receptionist and patient engagement CRM built on the official Meta WhatsApp Cloud API. Designed specifically for outpatient healthcare clinics, doctors, salons, coaching institutes, and service businesses in India.

## Core Capabilities
- **24/7 AI Receptionist**: Answers customer inquiries in under 2 seconds using custom business knowledge bases (doctor availability, service menus, pricing, FAQs).
- **Automated Appointment Booking**: Real-time slot reservation, doctor calendar sync, digital OPD passes, and reminder alerts.
- **Collaborative Team Inbox**: Multi-agent shared inbox with live staff takeover, chat assignments, and custom tagging on a single official WhatsApp number.
- **Automated Broadcasts**: Meta-compliant marketing broadcasts with 98% open rates and rich CTA buttons.
- **Security & Privacy**: Built with AES-256-GCM authenticated encryption, PostgreSQL Row-Level Security (RLS), and full alignment with India's DPDP Act 2023.

## Target Industries
- Healthcare Clinics, Polyclinics & Doctors (/solutions/clinics)
- Salons, Spas & Beauty Studios (/solutions/salons)
- Test Prep Coaching Institutes & Tutors (/solutions/coaching)
- Real Estate Developers & Brokers (/solutions/real-estate)

## Pricing Overview
- **Starter Plan**: ₹0 / Free tier with essential WhatsApp automation.
- **Professional Clinic Plan**: ₹1,999 / month with full AI receptionist, doctor scheduling, and team inbox.
- **Enterprise / Hospital Plan**: ₹4,999 / month with multi-doctor branches, custom workflows, and dedicated support.
